description.narrative: 1. Provide underprivileged youth with skills enabling them to escape poverty and secure stablelivelihoods.2. Help strengthen vocational training focused on formal employment in modern sectors andthereby respond to unmet demand for skilled technicians playing key roles in the economictransformation in Ethiopia and in the region.3. Engage a major multinational company in active provision of human resource developmentoutside its own organization, thus leveraging funds for development through new forms ofcooperation between a supplier of vocational training and the business sector.

A PPP-project within Vocational training in ethiopia. The partners are Volvo, Sida, UNIDO and Selam Vocational training academy. The aim of the project is to enable graduating youths to access formal employment within a relevant field one year after graduation.

Ett PPP-projekt inom yrkesutbildning i etiopien. Samverkan sker mellan Sida, UNIDO, Volvo och Selam Vocational Training Academy. Projektet syftar till att skapa möjlighet för ungdomar som tar examen att erhålla arbete inom den formella sektorn inom ett år.

Output I: A training academy for the operation and maintenance of commercial vehicles andindustrial and agricultural machinery established and operational in Ethiopia: - Training materials on DVDs;- Basic hydraulic and electrical training benches with accessories and hard- and soft-copymanuscripts;- Three Volvo engines (D12, D13, and D6);- Two hydraulic transmissions, turbo chargers, alternators and hydraulic cylinders;- A container with equipment such as special tools, more engines, gearboxes, axles and steeringwheels;- Project vehicle and server - purchased by UNIDO. Output II: New curriculum modules developed and approved by relevant authorities: - Training level I-IV successfully certified (concerning training of students), but level V is still waiting certification approval (Training of trainers) Output III: Instructors in technical fields trained abroad and instructors of support subjects trainedlocally and thus able to deliver up-to-date training courses regarding heavy-duty vehicles: - Training on a basic hydraulics system at Volvo (EBG) by a Volvo expert.- Training on a basic engine and related system at Volvo (EBG) by a Volvo expert.- Training on basic electrical systems at Selam by a Volvo expert. Output IV: Young trainees graduate annually in operations and maintenance of commercial vehicles: A total of 215 people graduated. Output V: Apprenticeship undertaken in relevant industries so students gain practical experience: -338 trainees participated in cooperative training.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
